original_metadata_description: Node-aware design-for-manufacturability agent. Opens the layout with the KLayout geometry engine and measures windowed pattern density, geometric litho-risk patterns (width/space/notch/isolated) and critical area; estimates random-defect yield with a Poisson model that gates on any defect size lacking a density, because dropping a term would raise the reported yield. Rule windows come from the PDK Binding and are never defaulted. Declares aerial-image, resist, process-window and OPC/RET analysis out of scope rather than reporting them clean. Validated on SkyWater sky130.
original_agent_description: Node-aware design-for-manufacturability agent. OPENS THE ACTUAL LAYOUT with the KLayout geometry engine and measures: windowed pattern density (per window, because a die-average can sit mid-window while individual windows are far outside the rule), geometric litho-risk patterns (features below the printability limit, gaps below the resolution limit, notches, isolated features), and critical area. Estimates random-defect yield with a Poisson model in which a defect size lacking a density is reported as UNPRICED and gates the run -- dropping a term would shrink lambda and so RAISE the reported yield. Rule windows and printability limits come from the PDK Binding and are never defaulted. Does NOT emit an OPC-readiness verdict: OPC is verified against a simulated printed image, which needs a calibrated optical and resist model, so aerial-image, resist, process-window and OPC/RET analysis are declared out of scope rather than reported as clean. Validated on SkyWater sky130.
